sealed_window: No input has data after 2026-09-29; the harness asserts the last QQQ session is 2026-09-29 (sealed window: never read data after 2026-10-30).

windows.main: 2000-03-09 to 2026-09-29 (QQQ calendar from 1999-03-10, measured from session START)
windows.oos: GSPC 1957-01-02 to 1999-12-31; M1 ^IXIC; M2 ^GSPC 1934-1956; M3 ^N225; M4 ^GDAXI; M5 ^FTSE (fe_config.MARKETS)
windows.slow_vol_history: EW-sigma and the 2,520-session mean start at the first QQQ (or OOS index) session; no pre-QQQ splice is used
